biological_interpretation: TUMOR BRAIN MICROENVIRONMENT ENRICHMENT: CD44 is enriched +1.6395 log2FC (p=3.01e-6, q=1.35e-4) in TBME vs BC.
COMPLEMENT MICROGLIAL/MYELOID SIGNATURE: C1QA enriched +1.9509 log2FC (q=6.36e-4) in TBME vs BC.
M2 MACROPHAGE/MICROGLIAL POLARIZATION: CD163 enriched +1.8197 log2FC (q=1.07e-3) in TBME vs BC.
PERITUMORAL M2 MYELOID CUFF: CD163 enriched +2.6753 log2FC (6.39-fold, q=2.86e-10) in TIME-B vs LB, co-localizing with the LRP1/APOE/C1Q myeloid sink.

IMMUNE EXCLUSION PROOF (Brain): CD45 (PTPRC) is enriched +1.9918 log2FC (3.98-fold, p=7.98e-11, q=3.11e-8) in peritumoral brain stroma (TIME-B) vs tumor core (LB), proving leukocytes are trapped in the peritumoral cuff rather than infiltrating the malignant BrM core.

PERITUMORAL ASTROCYTE/MICROGLIAL LRP1 LIGAND: APOE (endogenous LRP1 ligand) is enriched +3.3511 log2FC (10.20-fold, q=5.84e-8) in TIME-B vs LB, competing with Angiopep-2 for LRP1 binding in the peritumoral cuff.
PERITUMORAL COMPLEMENT SINK: C1QA enriched +2.9012 log2FC (q=2.97e-7) in TIME-B vs LB.
PERITUMORAL COMPLEMENT SINK: C1QB enriched +2.8111 log2FC (q=3.05e-7) in TIME-B vs LB.
PERITUMORAL COMPLEMENT SINK: C1QC enriched +2.9583 log2FC (q=5.56e-7) in TIME-B vs LB.

BRAIN PERITUMORAL PROTEASE GATE CANDIDATE: MMP2 is enriched +1.8732 log2FC (3.66-fold, p=4.39e-9, q=7.82e-7) in brain peritumoral stroma (TIME-B) vs tumor core (LB), supporting MMP2-cleavable stealth PEG de-shielding at the TIME-B/LB boundary.

CRITICAL OFF-TUMOR SINK: LRP1 is enriched +1.8066 log2FC (3.50-fold, p=9.92e-9, q=1.48e-6) in peritumoral brain immune microenvironment (TIME-B) vs lung brain metastasis tumor core (LB). Unmasked Angiopep-2/LRP1 nanocarriers face a 3.5x myeloid/microglial sink after BBB transcytosis unless dual-gated.
PERITUMORAL M2 MACROPHAGE MARKER (CD206): MRC1 enriched +1.6930 log2FC (q=7.64e-5) in TIME-B vs LB.
IMMUNE EXCLUSION PROOF (Lung Primary): CD45 (PTPRC) is enriched +2.1951 log2FC (4.58-fold, p=1.55e-14, q=1.20e-11) in primary lung peritumoral stroma (TIME-L) vs tumor nest (L).
PRIMARY LUNG STROMAL PROTEASE: MMP2 is enriched +3.0882 log2FC (8.50-fold, p=1.30e-13, q=4.95e-11) in primary lung stroma (TIME-L) vs tumor core (L).
PRIMARY LUNG STROMAL APOE: enriched +2.4666 log2FC (q=1.62e-7) in TIME-L vs L.

COMPARTMENT-SPECIFIC PROTEASE: MMP9 is significantly enriched in primary lung stroma TIME-L vs L (+1.8776 log2FC, p=1.19e-8, q=5.29e-7) but absent from brain TIME-B vs LB significant DEGs, indicating MMP9 is lung-stroma biased whereas MMP2 is active in both.
